decision.thesis: NO TRADE. THE 02:00 NOTE ASKED WHETHER A GENUINE SHELF OR A GENUINE FAILURE HAD FORMED AT 766.72 BY THIS CHECK. NEITHER DID - THE RANGE SIMPLY TIGHTENED. Over the 8h15m 5m window (16:50Z-01:05Z) BNBUSDT's ENTIRE range is 762.63-769.15 = 0.855%, and 23 OF 100 BARS CONTAIN 766.72 INSIDE THEIR RANGE, so the 02:00 magnet finding (eleven touches in 165 minutes) is not merely confirmed but is the dominant fact about the contract. FOUR CONSTRUCTIONS WERE PRICED - BNB LONG AND SHORT, ETH LONG AND SHORT - AND ALL FOUR FAIL THE L-004 SPAN SCREEN AT THEIR NEAREST STRUCTURAL TARGET (by 0.003pp, 0.010pp, 0.145pp and 0.236pp), WHILE ALL FOUR PASS IT ONLY BY JUMPING STRUCTURE THAT REJECTED WITHIN HOURS. That is L-004's predicted trade-off observed FOUR TIMES OUT OF FOUR IN A SINGLE CHECK, in both directions on both readable contracts, for the first time in the experiment. THE CENTRAL FINDING IS L-006: BNB's NOISE FLOOR COLLAPSED 0.403% -> 0.159%, A 2.5x FALL, WITH NOTHING PRINTING - the 17:15Z reclaim bar and every bar of consequence aged out of the preceding hour over six silent overnight hours, so the required span MECHANICALLY HALVED from 1.148% at 02:00 to 0.538% now. THE MARKET DID NOT MOVE; THE WINDOW DID. AND THE BEST CANDIDATE FAILS EVEN THE HALVED BAR, BY 0.003pp - re-measured against the honest 8h15m window containing the box actually being traded (N 0.403%, required 1.148%) the miss is 0.614pp, A TWO-HUNDRED-FOLD LARGER MISS. The crossing does not merely dissolve on re-measurement; IT NEVER OCCURRED. L-005 THEN REFUSES ALL FOUR INDEPENDENTLY OF EVERY GEOMETRIC FINDING: for each construction the side the trade must cross went unquoted, and BNBUSDT became THE FIRST CONTRACT OF THE EXPERIMENT CAUGHT UNQUOTED ON BOTH SIDES INSIDE ONE CHECK (ask 176 USDT at sample 1, bid 445 USDT at sample 5). THE EVIDENCE GATE IS NOT PASSED, AND IT FAILS ON INDEPENDENCE RATHER THAN ON COUNT: trend and market_context both support a BNB short on a bare count, but BNB's 24h -3.128% sits MID-PACK in a basket spanning -2.63% to -5.76%, showing no relative strength or weakness whatever, so market_context asserts only 'crypto is down' - the identical observation that makes trend down. Per the strategy's own independence requirement they are ONE observation, not two, while price_action actively OPPOSES (eight hours of higher lows 762.63 -> 765.20 -> 765.66 -> 766.35 -> 766.94) and volume is absent. LESSONS APPLIED: L-001 with the scan at 5m/1h/4h/daily - BTCUSDT excluded a NINETEENTH consecutive check with 4h and daily contamination UNCHANGED, SOLUSDT a NINTH (1h 570.0x, 4h 14.0x, daily 28.8x), XRPUSDT excluded with high24h STILL reading 1.6855, and BTC's clean 1h/5m scans recorded as a FLICKER, not a relaxation. L-002 applied and DECISIVE FOR A TENTH CONSECUTIVE CHECK, N stated FOUR WAYS, the magnet clause barring 766.72 in both directions and independently barring the BNB short's 769.30 stop (0.02% above a level touched twice in the preceding forty minutes) and the ETH long's 0.70x N sub-noise stop; tally NOT advanced, stands at ONE OF THREE. L-003 applied an ELEVENTH consecutive material check with BOTH forms inside the same check - the legitimate form decaying the BNB short 0.644 -> 0.235 as price drifted AWAY from a fixed stop, and the pathological form inflating the ETH long 0.633 -> 1.130 purely by risk shrinking, AT THE EXACT INSTANT ITS STOP FELL TO 0.54x N; clock stays at ZERO. L-004 applied FIRST, before any ratio, and is THE PRIMARY REFUSAL IN BOTH ITS FORMS, including a jumped level (769.15) that rejected THIRTY-FIVE MINUTES BEFORE THIS DECISION - sharper than the 02:00 note's 'inside the decision's own hour'. L-005 applied with FIVE sweeps for a TENTH consecutive check. L-006 applied to every window-derived figure, producing THREE instances of which TWO DISSOLVED. No lesson was loosened and no rule or risk limit was relaxed.
